profile.measurement: Actual linked 6510 CPU entry through RTS; monotonic Peddle counter deltas
exclusions: Synthetic host caller JSR (6 CPU cycles per scheduling call)
VIC contention, hardware timers, rendering, UCI/IEC waits
Guest 8088 cycle timing, XT ratio and physical C64U elapsed time
profile.source_identity_algorithm: SHA256 of ordered path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + NUL

configuration.dma_model: Functional synchronous copy; no DMA stall clocks
configuration.seed_algorithm: xorshift32: left13,right17,left5; low byte per address
configuration.warm_policy: Reuse same fixture/cache after previous workload and unmeasured coherent validation flush; Guest CPU registers/instruction counter reset outside measurement; monotonic host counters are retained and cache is not cleared. Above-cache workloads remain capacity limited.

limitations: Native startup initializes CPU/cache and copies immutable overlays, then idles; no native DOS boot or file import yet
FILE UCI behavior is modeled; no physical file/MORE/abort/persistence acceptance
Text row bitmap is tested; font/VIC presentation, keyboard scan and scheduler remain unlinked/private
REU overlay payloads are trusted immutable after bootstrap; native checks exact headers, not CRC
CPU cycles exclude REU stalls, rendering/device waits and physical elapsed time; near-XT speed remains unproved
INPUT overlay and cold image importer are future components, excluded from this slice
